reviewer.notes: Prospective key-free walkthrough from the blind packet only; it records learner habits, not completions.

records.passageBarrier: I may lose the thread when practical details are spread across several short paragraphs.
shortcutRisks: I may choose a familiar nearby phrase before checking whether it completes the grammar.
I may treat the notes as a summary and rely on memory instead of returning to the passage.
records.transferValue: This trains me to follow paraphrase across an informational passage without turning a note cue into a guess.
records.nextAction: Underline the grammatical slot in each note, then verify one contiguous passage phrase before recording anything.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may mistake a broad description for the specific reason requested.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Count the proposed words after removing surrounding note text; keep at two or fewer.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: the sentence sounds natural with several invented choices.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Search for the passage statement that explains why the service is used.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Confirm the chosen wording is uninterrupted in the passage.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Read the whole note sentence and check that the phrase describes the required noun.
questionWalkthrough.spellingCheck: Copy the passage spelling exactly, including any inflection.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Reject a nearby idea if it answers a different part of the note.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Choose only wording that satisfies meaning, grammar, and the limit together.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: If two options remain, reread the full source sentence before deciding.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may supply a plausible destination from general knowledge rather than the passage.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Use no more than two copied words.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: High: the category invites common-sense guessing.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Locate the delivery description and compare every listed destination carefully.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Keep the final wording as one continuous source span.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Check that the phrase matches the plural pattern after the connector.
questionWalkthrough.spellingCheck: Preserve the passage form rather than changing singular or plural.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Do not select another location merely because it is also mentioned later.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Use the item that belongs to the same source list as the cue.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Return to the list and trace its punctuation before finalising.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may confuse a timing detail with the reason for that timing.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Check that the selected span has two words or fewer.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: a routine-related phrase can be guessed too broadly.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Find the farming-routine example and separate the scheduling trigger from its explanation.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Verify that the copied phrase occurs consecutively.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Ensure the phrase follows the time preposition naturally.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Reject another time reference from a different local setting.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Prefer the phrase tied directly to the named routine.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Reread the sentence on both sides of the candidate phrase.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may choose an associated service feature instead of the item being evaluated.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: One or two copied words are allowed; do not add an article unless it is in the source span.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: the comparison cue makes several service features seem possible.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Search for the comparison with collection size.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Check that the candidate is an exact uninterrupted span.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Read the comparison aloud to confirm a singular noun fits.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Exclude a related planning detail that is not part of the comparison.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Choose the term explicitly evaluated against collection size.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Mark the comparison words and reread their immediate context.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may combine two support activities instead of isolating the requested object.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Keep the copied object within the two-word cap.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: institutional terms can sound interchangeable.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Find the sentence describing staff assistance and distinguish its separate actions.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Use only consecutive words from the source.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Check that the phrase is a suitable object after the verb.
questionWalkthrough.spellingCheck: Retain the passage’s plural form if used.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Reject another organisation mentioned for partnership purposes.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Select the object tied directly to the specified assistance action.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Compare the verb-object relationship in note and passage.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may overlook the final member of a three-part partnership list.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Do not exceed two copied words.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: High: many community partners are plausible from background knowledge.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Locate the partnership list and track the member required by the note structure.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Confirm the words are adjacent in the list.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Check agreement with the plural list pattern.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Do not substitute organisations named elsewhere for a different role.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Use the listed partner that completes this exact sequence.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Recheck the list from its first item through its last.

records.passageBarrier: I can follow the topic, but precise process vocabulary may blur together when I read quickly.
shortcutRisks: I may turn a familiar agriculture concept into my own wording instead of copying a passage span.
I may choose the first related term I see without testing the note’s grammar.
records.transferValue: This helps me slow down around technical descriptions and distinguish a process, condition, and outcome.
records.nextAction: For each gap, identify the required grammar first and use surrounding source context to eliminate related terms.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may confuse the return point with an earlier stage in the cycle.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Use a source span of two words or fewer.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: a farming cycle encourages familiar assumptions.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Find the sentence that describes the borrowing-and-return sequence.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Make sure the candidate is consecutive in the passage.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Check that a noun fits naturally after the preposition.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Reject a related stage if the passage assigns it a different action.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Choose the stage explicitly linked to returning, not merely to growing.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Reread the entire sequence before choosing.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may select a different environmental benefit because several are presented together.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Check the candidate stays within two words.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: High: general knowledge makes several conditions sound likely.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Locate the list of locally valuable traits and match the note’s relationship.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Confirm that the proposed words appear side by side.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Ensure the phrase works after the verb in the note.
questionWalkthrough.spellingCheck: Use the passage spelling with no synonym substitution.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Eliminate other traits from the same list that answer a different cue.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Choose the trait that completes the exact note relationship.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Compare the note verb with each item in the source list.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may write a broad description instead of the specific recorded information type.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Use no more than two source words.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: documentation fields are easy to invent.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Find the record-keeping sentence and distinguish each field in its list.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Check that it completes the coordinated list grammatically.
questionWalkthrough.spellingCheck: Retain the source number and spelling.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Reject a field that belongs to a later explanation rather than the record list.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Use the information category directly named alongside the other records.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Trace the list punctuation before committing.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may focus on the image itself rather than the action it enables.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Use one or two words only and do not add an ending not present in the passage.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: several learning actions are plausible.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Read the sentence about photographs and identify the learner action stated there.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Check that the final wording is continuous.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Ensure it follows the note’s verb pattern.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Reject a verb from another sentence that describes a different task.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Choose the action directly enabled by the photographs.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Read the note aloud with the candidate to test form.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may merge several storage requirements into an overlong answer.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Select only the single required quality or an allowed contiguous phrase.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: storage conditions are closely related.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Find the storage requirements and isolate the quality paired with the cue.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Confirm the proposed wording is exactly consecutive.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Check that the adjective completes the parallel description.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Do not choose another storage condition simply because it appears nearby.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Use the condition that matches the note’s stated pairing.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Separate each item in the source list before deciding.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may use a general food term instead of the exact companion category.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Keep the answer at two words or fewer.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: High: everyday knowledge supplies many plausible food words.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Locate the educational example involving food preparation and examine its paired categories.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Confirm a plural noun completes the coordination.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Reject ingredients mentioned in a different illustrative context.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Choose the category explicitly coordinated with the given one.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Recheck the exact pair rather than relying on food knowledge.

records.passageBarrier: I may skim familiar public-place vocabulary and miss distinctions between access, staffing, and policy.
shortcutRisks: I may answer from what libraries usually offer instead of what this passage states.
I may confuse a general service detail with a condition that belongs to the pilot or rules.
records.transferValue: This builds the habit of separating closely related operational details before choosing a short exact span.
records.nextAction: Pause at contrasts and lists, then test every candidate against the note sentence before copying it.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may replace the stated setting with a more general study location.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Use one or two source words only.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: the sentence invites a common-sense location guess.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Find the opening description of which learners the spaces support.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Confirm the wording is a contiguous source span.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Check that the noun follows the location preposition correctly.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Reject a location mentioned only as part of the facility description.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Choose the setting directly tied to the learners’ need.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Reread the full contrast between learner need and service provision.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may include a facility that is unavailable rather than one users can access.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Keep to two words or fewer.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: High: standard library services make a tempting shortcut.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Read the access list and its contrast with closed services.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Use adjacent words exactly as they occur.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Ensure the phrase completes the coordinated facilities list.
questionWalkthrough.spellingCheck: Do not alter the source form.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Exclude facilities described as closed or outside the access list.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Select only an item explicitly available to visitors.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Mark the contrast words before rereading the list.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may confuse a staffing observation with a building condition.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Use the shortest exact passage wording within the limit.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: several operational needs could fit without evidence.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Find what staff assess near the entrance during the trial.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Confirm the words form one unbroken span.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Check that the noun works after the quantifier in the note.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Reject a later practical issue that is not assessed near entrances.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Choose the need directly linked to the entrance check.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Use the location cue to rule out other pilot details.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may treat an outdoor detail as if it referred to an indoor room.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Keep the copied span within two words.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: building vocabulary can be inferred too easily.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Locate the practical-issues example and use its spatial wording precisely.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Verify the candidate is consecutive in the passage.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Read the note sentence to confirm a noun fits the preposition.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Reject another place mentioned in the broader service description.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Choose the place directly modified by the outdoor detail.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Recheck the local context around the practical issue.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may choose a physical feature instead of the location category the signs clarify.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Use no more than two exact source words.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: several parts of the building are discussed.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Find the design sentence about clear signs and identify what they distinguish.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Make sure the answer is an uninterrupted span.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Check plural agreement with the note verb.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Reject another design feature that serves monitoring rather than clarification.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Choose the category that the signs explicitly identify.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Compare the function of signs with the function of other design features.

questionWalkthrough.likelyMisread: I may confuse the rule’s requirement with the group affected by it.
questionWalkthrough.wordLimitCheck: Keep the selected source words within the stated cap.
questionWalkthrough.promptOnlyGuessRisk: Medium: policy language can sound predictable without checking evidence.
questionWalkthrough.evidenceSearch: Locate the policy limitation and separate the requirement from the people it concerns.
questionWalkthrough.passageSpanCheck: Confirm the candidate occurs as one continuous phrase.
questionWalkthrough.grammarRecheck: Check that the noun completes the note naturally.
questionWalkthrough.competitorCheck: Reject nearby rules about behaviour or booking that solve different issues.
questionWalkthrough.decisionRule: Choose the stated requirement attached to the relevant group.
questionWalkthrough.repairAction: Reread the policy sentence without using general expectations.
